name: Spellcraft Coverage Projection
status: broad 50-sign coverage projection; not the first learner lesson
purpose: A broad Cuspell spellcraft coverage projection retained from the SRD 5.1 level 0-2 stress test. It demonstrates how much effect diversity fits inside 50 registered signs, but it is not the learning target. The current 11-sign core, 18-sign beginner course, 24-sign intermediate composition course, and 29-sign advanced extension live in spellcraft_progression_v1.json.
rules: flat tight local application first; parentheses are fallback only
rune-label:Cuspell-witness / $name binders in triggered, multi-target, or fresh-result examples

direct_manipulation.purpose: Immediate cantrip-like manipulation with context-selected targets.

persistent_and_protective.purpose: Persistent states, wards, healing/status effects, capability buffs, and simple combat protection.

transformation_and_programming.purpose: Second-tier transformation, repeated/composite effects, objective collection-based multi-target application, and triggered magic.

fresh_creation.purpose: Fresh Entity allocation with an explicit post-creation profile and optional immediate use of the fresh result.

reference_effects.note: Create one fresh light-emitting Entity at Here, then set its Light output to one canonical light unit. This is a creation-family effect, not a mutation of a pre-existing target; exact orb/shape realization remains a deterministic world-profile detail.
Restore recognized structural wholeness of a selected object.
Remote magical movement of a selected object to a salient destination.
Cause the addressee to receive the selected information as hearing.

reference_effects.cuspell: Change This Heat Add BeforeValue Heat This «HeatUnit» @!
reference_effects.note: Raise the target's Heat by one canonical heat unit; D&D attack/damage mechanics are not copied.

reference_effects.cuspell: Change This Heat Add BeforeValue Heat This Opposite «HeatUnit» @!
reference_effects.note: Lower the target's Heat by one canonical heat unit.
Impose a pathological state; this is not a dedicated poison-damage model.
Actively maintain Life through the selected interval.
Force the addressee to have a visual sensing event of a prepared stimulus; persistent illusion ontology is not yet a starter feature.

reference_effects.cuspell: Change This Heat Add BeforeValue Heat This «HeatUnit» @!
reference_effects.note: One representative minor utility manipulation; the SRD spell bundles many unrelated tricks.

reference_effects.note: Create a finite watcher that alerts the caster when an Entity touches the warded subject.
Begin a positive attitude from the explicitly designated creature toward the caster.
Begin a positive attitude toward the caster; D&D charm-condition edge rules are not imported.
Grant comprehension of selected information rather than universal language access.
Set the target's Health to the exact Health value of the caster as a designated reference.
Same healing-state pattern; range/action economy is outside the starter language target.
Magically perceive whether/that a selected subject carries the Magic state; broad area search still needs explicit selection.

reference_effects.cuspell: Each Collect :«This»:This Member $«This» This :«That»:This Change $«That» Light «LightUnit» @!
reference_effects.note: Make every Entity in an explicitly designated Group luminous; the D&D advantage mechanic and area-selection rule are not copied.

reference_effects.note: Create one fresh living friendly cat-like creature at the caster's location; telepathy, dismissal, spirit metaphysics, and other D&D familiar rules are not copied.
Grant a selected movement capability; this is not a numeric speed-stat bonus.

reference_effects.note: Allocate three fresh arrow-like projectile identities and immediately move each toward the designated destination. D&D force damage and automatic-hit mechanics are not copied.
Prevent onset of pathological state during the selected interval.
Prevent attacks from an explicitly designated attacker during the interval; this is stronger/narrower than D&D AC arithmetic depending on world rules.
Begin the target's sleep state.
Push an explicitly designated target to a designated location; sonic damage and area geometry are not copied.
Transform selected Form toward an exact explicitly designated reference profile.
Set a selected light-emitting subject to zero Light; area-wide optical rules require a richer world model.
Grant capability to see a selected stimulus; universal low-light vision remains a broader capability description.
Representative capability enhancement rather than a D&D ability-score mechanic.
Copy an exact reference Form/geometry profile whose registered scale gives the desired larger or smaller body; no vague relative-size command is used.
Maintain structural wholeness/preservation through a selected interval.
Force an explicitly designated target toward a designated destination; continuous wind-field physics are not encoded.

reference_effects.cuspell: Change This Heat Add BeforeValue Heat This «HeatUnit» @!
reference_effects.note: Raise selected metal object's Heat by an exact amount.
Hold the selected target at a designated location through the interval.
Prevent one explicitly designated observer from visually sensing the target; all-observer invisibility uses collection machinery.
End the selected object's Locked state.
End the target's pathological Ill state; other conditions need their own semantics.
Move the target to a designated elevated location; sustained suspension can add At/Persist.

Begin the Magic state on the selected weapon/object.

Break structural wholeness of the selected target; sonic area/damage details are not imported.
